row:
A specialist chiropractic and health clinic in Dublin city center where we endeavor to get you back on your feet and pain free and active as soon as possible. With over 10years experience providing Dublin with world class spinal health care.

Our Chiropractors are all registered and insured through the chiropractic association of Ireland, adhering to the highest professional standards of education and continued development. Utilizing the most modern, effective and comfortable chiropractic treatment available. Making us the best chiropractors in Dublin 2 & achieving phenomenal results.


 Call on 016444555 for an appointment today, based at 34 Upper Fitzwilliam Street D02 T207

https://www.dublincitychiropractic.ie/new-patients/
